summary: Iter 44 — Verified the new proactive header PlanLimitBadge for company_admin. Cleanup verified post-test: plan restored to 'company_enterprise', TEST_ compounds deleted, total compounds = 1 (original baseline)
critical_code_review_comments: PlanLimitBadge.js is clean and defensive: role-gates twice (effect + render), fails silently on fetch error, uses a 60s background refresh as a safety net in addition to the planUsageRefresh event. Good belt-and-suspenders pattern.

Minor code observation (non-blocking): the badge uses `hidden md:inline-flex`, so it is invisible on mobile by design. If ever desired for tablet/mobile, consider a compact icon-only variant. Current behavior matches the request's 'desktop viewport' note.

During Playwright clicks on the badge, element.click() reported 'not visible' due to a brief auto-stability check (likely a transient header layout shift from an ad-banner). Dispatching click via JS worked consistently. Not a product bug, but if the header has any CLS/reflow during initial mount, a quick data-testid-scoped container with `min-height` could reduce flakiness of click-handlers in e2e tests.

GlobalUIProvider already listens for openUpgradeDialog (verified iter 42-43); the new badge dispatches the same event — so the wiring re-uses the proven manual+auto-open path without introducing new state. Solid design.
